rules: Do NOT modify tasks.json or progress.md
All script paths use $RALPH_DIR in bash, RALPH_DIR in python
No external Python dependencies except dotenv
bash -n ralph.sh must pass after changes
Commit with message format: feat(TASK_ID): title

notes: complexity and required_context are part of the standard Ralph task schema
agents should treat required_context as guaranteed high-signal file input

R1.5.name: Reliability
R1.5.description: Fix edge cases, prevent hangs, circuit breakers, retry logic

R3.name: Agent Quality
R3.description: Context injection, memory system, model routing, smart prompts

R4.name: Packaging
R4.description: CLI tool, config, multi-project, vector DB, parallel execution

tasks.title: Circuit breaker for agent failures
tasks.description: Track consecutive failures per agent (coder/lead). After 3 consecutive failures in a row, stop pipeline, set state to paused, notify human via Telegram. Reset failure counter on any success. Add FAILURE_COUNT variable to ralph.sh main loop. On codex exit code != 0 and not timeout, increment counter. On success, reset to 0. On counter >= 3, call ralph_notify.py with alert message and break loop.
acceptance_criteria: ralph.sh tracks failure count per agent cycle
Pipeline stops after 3 consecutive failures
Telegram alert is sent when circuit breaker trips
bash -n ralph.sh passes

tasks.title: Exponential backoff on codex failures
tasks.description: When codex exec fails (non-zero exit, not timeout), retry with exponential backoff. Retry delays: 60s, 120s, 300s. On rate limit detection (grep stderr for 'rate limit' or 'throttl' or '429'), pause 1800s (30 min). After 3 retries exhausted, mark task as failed and continue to next. Add RETRY_COUNT, MAX_RETRIES=3, RETRY_DELAYS=(60 120 300) to ralph.sh. Wrap codex exec call in retry loop.
acceptance_criteria: ralph.sh retries failed codex runs with 60/120/300 backoff
Rate limit patterns trigger 30-minute pause
After max retries task is marked failed and pipeline continues
bash -n ralph.sh passes

tasks.title: Structured task summaries after completion
